source: EN 1992-1-1 and EN 1998-1 Section 5 (materials of reinforced concrete); EN 1993-1-1 for steel

sources.concreteStrain: SAEngine practice for the checks the EN methods do not replace (EN 1992-1-1 Table 3.1: εcu3 3.5 ‰ in concreteMethods)
sources.seismicFcMin: EN 1998-1 5.4.1.1(1)P: concrete of primary seismic members of DCM not below C16/20 (DCH 5.5.1.1(1)P: C20/25)
sources.lightweightFcMax: SAEngine practice: the value of the pack this one extends, kept where the Eurocodes give no value or the pack does not enter one yet (see VERIFY.md)
sources.lightweightDensity: EN 1992-1-1 11.1: lightweight aggregate concrete of closed structure, density at most 2200 kg/m³
sources.seismicRebarFy: EN 1998-1 5.4.1.1(2)P and 5.5.1.1(3)P: B500 reinforcement of class B or C (EN 1992-1-1 Annex C, Table C.1), class C in the critical regions of DCH
sources.gradeTolerance: SAEngine practice: the value of the pack this one extends, kept where the Eurocodes give no value or the pack does not enter one yet (see VERIFY.md)
sources.fyActualMargin: EN 1998-1 5.5.1.1(3)P: the upper characteristic yield strength at most 25 % above the nominal (125 MPa for B500)
sources.fuFyMin: EN 1992-1-1 Table C.1: k = (ft/fy)k at least 1.08 (class B; class C 1.15)
